_comment: ENGM-1: the engine capability matrix. Rows are storage engines, columns are capabilities, and every cell is a CLAIM tied to the CI job that witnesses it.
A cell is {claim, witnessJob, note}. claim is supported | partial | unsupported. witnessJob is '<workflow file>#<job id>' naming a real `jobs:` key under .github/workflows/, or null.
supported / partial REQUIRE a witnessJob; unsupported must NOT carry one. 'unsupported' here means 'no CI job proves it', not 'the code path does not exist' -- the note says which.
partial = a job exercises part of the capability (a narrower scope, a different layer, or a different mechanism) and the note says exactly what is and is not covered.
Checked statically by scripts/quality/check-engine-matrix.py (aiKnowledge gate), which parses the workflow YAML: a claim can never outlive its witness, and a witness can never be a typo.

To upgrade a cell, add or extend a CI job that really exercises it FIRST, then point witnessJob at it. Never edit a claim up without a job; never leave a witness pointing at a job that no longer covers the cell.
The local H2-in-compat-mode runs and the SqlDialect.capabilities() declarations are NOT witnesses (storage-dialect-conformance.yml: 'Never claim MySQL support from a green local run alone').

boot.note: NPDevSamples/journeys is an H2Local jwt app generated, built, booted on a wiped DB and driven over REST and a real browser on every push to main and nightly.

additive_migration.note: The RuntimeHost gate runs the runtimehost-core suite (MissingTableCreationPassTest, NewConceptSchemaProvisionerTest, MigrationPreflightTest on H2). No booted-app Tier C evolution vector runs on H2.

destructive_migration_ack.note: SurplusDropFlowH2Test and the schema-drop snapshot tests run in the RuntimeHost gate against a real H2; the acknowledgment REST flow on a booted app is not driven in CI.

promotion_target.note: H2 is the SOURCE of `npdev db promote` (H2 -> Postgres etc.). No CI job promotes into an H2 target.

backup.note: ScheduledH2BackupTest (OPS-10): online BACKUP TO into a directory with newest-N retention, against a real file H2, inside the RuntimeHost gate.

restore_drill.note: DataExportImportRoundTripH2Test and SchemaVaultStoreTest prove the data export/snapshot restore round trip; no test restores a ScheduledH2Backup zip into a fresh database and boots the app on it.

pagination.note: kernelQualityGate runs :kernel:test, whose DialectConformanceTierBTest vectors (limit, non-overlapping pages, offset past the end) run against H2 by default.

json_search.note: No engine-side JSON path query exists in the kernel or runtime-support (no JSON_VALUE / jsonb operators). Only JSON round-trip storage is witnessed (vectors J1/J2).

flow_durability.note: JdbcFlowInstanceStoreClaimTest (in flowinstance-postgres) proves the SKIP LOCKED claim/lease against a real H2 (no double-resume, expired claim reclaimable). No test kills the process and resumes a waiting flow from H2.

boot.note: A generated app boots, serves CRUD, round-trips non-BMP unicode and preserves rows across a restart against the pinned postgres image (matrix leg postgres).

additive_migration.note: Tier C E1 (nullable column added, rows preserved) and E2 (renamedFrom moves data) run through NPDev's own schema engine against the real engine.

destructive_migration_ack.note: No real-engine job drives a destructive change through the acknowledgment flow. The mechanism is engine-agnostic and only H2-witnessed; Tier C deliberately forces allowDestructiveRecreate=false.

promotion_target.note: `npdev db promote` exists and docs name Postgres as the usual target, but no CI job runs a promotion into a real Postgres.

backup.note: PostgresDialect declares SNAPSHOT_RESTORE but no conformance vector or job takes a backup; the generated toolbox parity job covers start/stop/status/reset, not backup.

restore_drill.note: No CI restore drill on Postgres. The pre-drop JSONL snapshot restore (`npdev db restore`) is witnessed on H2 only.

pagination.note: Tier B against a real pinned Postgres: limitReturnsExactlyN, pagesDoNotOverlapOrGap, offsetPastTheEndReturnsNothing, limitOnlyCaps; app-on-engine also asserts a filtered, ordered query path.

json_search.note: No JSON path query is implemented. jsonb round-trip is witnessed (storage-dialect-conformance.yml#conformance J1/J2) but that is storage, not search.

flow_durability.note: flowinstance-postgres Testcontainers tests (PostgresFlowInstanceStoreTest) plus the generated-app Postgres integration tests (AsyncWaitResumeE2EIT) run against a real Postgres. Not run on pull requests.

boot.note: Same app-on-engine proof as Postgres on the pinned mysql image, forced to utf8mb4 (matrix leg mysql); doctor must also fail a utf8mb3 server (doctor-charset-fixture).

additive_migration.note: Tier C E1/E2 against a real MySQL. MySQL commits DDL implicitly (no DDL_IN_TRANSACTION), so a half-applied migration cannot be rolled back; that is a declared limit, not a gap in this cell.

destructive_migration_ack.note: No real-engine job drives a destructive change through the acknowledgment flow; MySQL's implicit DDL commit makes this the cell most worth a real witness.

promotion_target.note: No CI job promotes a database into a real MySQL.

backup.note: MySqlDialect does not declare SNAPSHOT_RESTORE and no job takes a MySQL backup.

restore_drill.note: No CI restore drill on MySQL.

pagination.note: Tier B against a real pinned MySQL 8.4 (same vectors as Postgres), plus the app-on-engine query path.

json_search.note: No JSON path query is implemented; JSON column round-trip is witnessed (J1/J2), search is not.

flow_durability.note: docs/FLOWS.md names JdbcFlowInstanceStore for Postgres/H2 only; no CI job resumes a waiting flow on MySQL.

boot.note: Same app-on-engine proof on the pinned mssql/server:2022 image (matrix leg sqlserver), including the non-BMP unicode assertion that originally exposed the VARCHAR/NVARCHAR gap.

additive_migration.note: Tier C E1/E2 against a real SQL Server.

destructive_migration_ack.note: No real-engine job drives a destructive change through the acknowledgment flow.

promotion_target.note: No CI job promotes a database into a real SQL Server.

backup.note: The generated `backup` sidecar takes a BACKUP DATABASE ... CHECKSUM .bak into ./backups on the pinned mssql/server image (sqlserver leg, 'Backup drill' steps).

restore_drill.note: The generated `backup-verify` job restores that .bak into a scratch server, DBCC CHECKDB passes and the seeded rows read back (sqlserver leg, 'Backup drill' steps).

pagination.note: Tier B against a real pinned SQL Server 2022 (OFFSET/FETCH spelling), plus the app-on-engine query path.

json_search.note: No JSON path query is implemented; JSON is stored as nvarchar(max) and only its round-trip is witnessed (J1/J2).

flow_durability.note: docs/FLOWS.md names JdbcFlowInstanceStore for Postgres/H2 only; no CI job resumes a waiting flow on SQL Server.
